dod_intent_evidence: Genuine and deep DoD motion (defense-grade ASVs, GPS-denial ops, Group 1/2 UAS compatibility), but they've crossed the valley: a $24M FY-26 APFIT award — a program that exists specifically to 'accelerate and scale production' of already-validated tech recommended by the Navy and Marine Corps — funds scaling Lightfish production, not a stuck prototype (News section, three independent outlets).
what_they_do: Builds long-endurance autonomous surface vessels (Lightfish, Quickfish, Heavyfish) for maritime domain awareness and defense/commercial/scientific missions; just won a $24M APFIT award to scale production.
